criteria.reason: Closest non-spiking single-pulse inhibitory calibration candidate; no task outcome used. Gain is very large and phenomenological. This is no longer the unchanged Hippocampome model.
criteria.physiology_gate: CA3 five-pulse100Hz train must show lower total CA2 pyramidal spiking with fitted inhibition than with blocked inhibition. Zero evoked spikes under fitted inhibition is a stronger qualitative match; do not interpret 128 or18956 model cells as animal replicates or require exact6/8 fraction.

numerical_gate.comparison: 10 vs20 RK4 substeps per ms, same events and graph seed
numerical_gate.low_count_rule: If both counts <=1, an absolute difference <=1 passes; otherwise denominator max(counts,1).

criteria.MEC_gate: Qualitative evoked excitability check only; no published LII train spike fraction is available. Report silent responses; do not substitute LIII targets.
criteria.remaining: Passing these screens alone does not establish biological validity; source/default, reversal, gain and independent-seed sensitivity are required.

limitations: Neuron counts are model observations, not experimental replicates.
Inhibitory gain180 is fitted and extremely large, not a measured estimate.
The recording recipe estimates ECl, not directly measured EGABA.
A successful qualitative check does not establish a validated biological CA2 model.
CARLsim subsecond console summaries divide by an integer zero duration and show NaN rates; measurements here come from complete binary spike and voltage monitors.
